reason: I'd use the free first visit, but paying $13 plus gas every time doesn't fit on $42k with two kids. The library and the park cost me nothing.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, so a $13 visit really costs me more like $20. I can't do that more than once in a while.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $8 for the 4-year-old with the baby free, or a punch pack that works out near $8 a visit, if the place is close enough that gas isn't a big add-on.
